content_voiceover: This is the SORMAIN trial data, showing that sorafenib maintenance therapy reduces relapse and death after allogeneic transplant for FLT3 dash ITD positive AML. Panel A shows relapse free survival, with a hazard ratio of zero point three nine and a log rank P value of zero point zero one three favoring sorafenib. At twenty four months, relapse free survival was eighty five percent with sorafenib compared to fifty three point three percent with placebo, which is a striking absolute difference. Panel B shows overall survival, with sorafenib giving ninety point five percent survival at twenty four months versus sixty six point two percent with placebo, hazard ratio zero point five one six. This trial established that FLT3 inhibitor maintenance after transplant meaningfully reduces relapse risk in FLT3 ITD positive AML, and sorafenib was the first agent to show this benefit, predating gilteritinib data.
keypoints: SORMAIN trial: sorafenib maintenance post allo-HCT in FLT3-ITD AML
Twenty four month RFS eighty five percent vs fifty three point three percent, HR zero point three nine
Twenty four month OS ninety point five percent vs sixty six point two percent
Sorafenib was first FLT3 inhibitor shown to improve post-transplant outcomes
keypoint_voiceover: SORMAIN showed sorafenib maintenance after transplant nearly doubles relapse free survival in FLT3 ITD positive AML, from about fifty three percent to eighty five percent at two years, with a clear overall survival benefit too.
